title: CMU Undergraduate Research Office (URO)
description:
The Undergraduate Research Office is CMU's central hub for getting into research: it advises students on finding a faculty mentor, runs the getting-started workshops, and administers the university's research grants and summer fellowships below — open to undergraduates in every college.

title: SURG — Small Undergraduate Research Grants (CMU)
compensation_details: Up to $1,000 per project (more for groups)
description: SURG funds student-designed research projects during the academic year — up to $1,000 for materials and expenses (more for group projects), with proposals reviewed each semester. Any CMU undergraduate in any discipline can apply with a faculty advisor.
description_clean: SURG funds student-designed research projects during the academic year — up to $1,000 for materials and expenses (more for group projects), with proposals reviewed each semester. Any CMU undergraduate in any discipline can apply with a faculty advisor.

title: CMU Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships
description: URO's summer fellowships fund CMU undergraduates to spend the summer on full-time research with a faculty mentor — a stipend in place of a summer job so students can commit to a research project in any field, from engineering to the humanities.
description_clean: URO's summer fellowships fund CMU undergraduates to spend the summer on full-time research with a faculty mentor — a stipend in place of a summer job so students can commit to a research project in any field, from engineering to the humanities.

title: HURAY — Hourly Undergraduate Research Apprenticeships (CMU)
description: HURAY pays first- and second-year students an hourly wage to apprentice in a faculty member's research group during the academic year — an entry route into research designed for students with no prior experience, matched through participating faculty projects.
description_clean: HURAY pays first- and second-year students an hourly wage to apprentice in a faculty member's research group during the academic year — an entry route into research designed for students with no prior experience, matched through participating faculty projects.

title: ISURG — International Small Undergraduate Research Grants (CMU)
description: ISURG extends CMU's undergraduate research grants to projects with an international dimension — funding travel and expenses for student research conducted abroad or in collaboration with international partners, with a faculty advisor's sponsorship.
